enemy-047-atarax-controller.designLock: One original Tantalus Frontier ATARAX human network operator: realistic adult human proportions, readable human face, compact technical headset or low-profile open control helmet, dark industrial control suit, protected short cables, compact back module, chest-mounted neural console, forearm brace and one small secondary defensive sidearm only. Anthracite, gunmetal, black insulation, restrained amber status lamps and at most one small blue feedback light. The silhouette is technical and lightly protected, never heavy infantry, scientist recolor, cyber-mage, Xenoborg or controlled xenomorph. Strict right-facing orthographic gameplay profile. All future pixels are original project art; no external model exists and no licensed character may be used as a visual substitute.
